parsed.rationale: Both participating records are mock types named `MockArtworkService` living under test file paths (`NowPlayingServiceTests.swift` and `ArtworkServiceTests.swift`). Test mocks are routinely duplicated per test suite to keep each suite self-contained and to allow independent evolution of test behaviour without cross-suite coupling. Because all participating records reside in test targets, Decision Rule 1 (test-fixture) applies and no refactor action is warranted.
